title: Closing identification (hence C1/C2 membership) depends on the order of same-second opposite-side fills in one instrument; not disclosed or measured in the M2-C reports
location: portfolio_engine/reports/M2C_CLOSING_BATCH_REPORT.md (§1,§3,§8 silent); docs/POSITION_BASKET_ONTOLOGY.md §3.3 (documents it for episode numbering only)
evidence: [IMPL] own replay with tie order sells_first / buys_first within (instrument, second) changes the open/close split of 2 / 4 fills; closing portions (17,760), units (1,377,065) and parents (16,817) are unchanged, but memberships change: 1 batch replaced at every threshold for sells_first (2 for buys_first); portions in changed batches 9/9/9/171/171 (sells_first) and 10/16/16/322/322 (buys_first) at g=2/5/10/30/60. ambiguity_result.json REPLAY_*.
impact: Result stated as convention-independent observed layer; batch membership is in fact sensitive to a documented M1 tie convention for 1-2 batches (up to 322 closing portions at 30/60 s). Small, but undisclosed in Model C.
proposed_fix: Add a sentence + the measured table to M2C report §3/§8 and the evidence registry; keep file order (src) as the stated convention.
proposed_test: Regression test building a synthetic same-second buy/sell on a closed contract and asserting the documented tie convention and the number of affected closing portions.

title: Stream boundary (underlying x expiry x session) is stricter than the approved D2 text ("consecutive parents of one underlying") and is not flagged as an interpretation
location: docs/BASKET_GROUPING_METHODOLOGY.md D2 vs python/pe/closing_batches.py:3,19; M2C report §1
evidence: [IMPL] stream=underlying only, underlying x session, underlying x expiry give identical closing-portion partitions at all 10 views on the full ledger (ambiguity_result.json STREAM_*: 0 changed batches) - impact measured nil on this data.
impact: None on the committed data; would matter on data with concurrent expiries or overnight activity. Interpretation not recorded as such (the report lists only tie order and C2 reference as decisions).
proposed_fix: Record the stream definition as an interpretation of D2 with the nil measured impact.
proposed_test: Synthetic two-expiry same-session case asserting the documented boundary behaviour (already partly covered).

title: Tie-break wording: approved text says "first source_row_id of the parent"; implementation uses the smallest CLOSING source_row_id
evidence: [IMPL] alternative keys (min row over all fills of the parent; parent id only; numeric-aware id; reversed id; last-fill) give 0 change for C1 (provably tie-invariant) and 0 or 1 batch for C2 (parent-id-only and last-then-row give 1 batch fewer at 2/5/10 s; min-row-any, numeric-aware and reversed give 0).
impact: At most one batch at 2/5/10 s (C2 only).
proposed_fix: State the implemented reading explicitly in D2 together with the measured table.
proposed_test: Existing equal-timestamp tests suffice; add one with a mixed parent whose opening row precedes its closing rows.

title: Existing test suite lets a reporting-layer mutation survive and kills three others only through a committed-output hash snapshot
evidence: [IMPL]/mutation: M22 (pairs_linked uses < instead of <=) -> 25/25 tests pass; M14, M25, M26 killed only by test_real_outputs_reproduce_the_committed_manifest ([REPRO], not independent). Own reference kills all four. mutations.json.
impact: Headline report table (pairs linked / gap == g) is not independently asserted; snapshot tests would also pass if outputs and code were regenerated together.
proposed_fix: Assert summarize() rows against a hand-built synthetic expectation; assert total_closing_qty, join_gap_s and numbering directly.
proposed_test: Synthetic 3-parent scenario with known gaps 0/g/g+1 checking pairs_linked, pairs_gap_exactly_threshold, pairs_gap_threshold_plus_1s.

title: Missing / NaN timestamps are not validated: engine fails with an incidental TypeError/ValueError inside replay/formatting
evidence: [IMPL] synthetic Fill with timestamp None -> TypeError in replay.py:30; NaN -> ValueError (format code d). No silent mis-grouping; no test.
impact: Loud failure only; raw data has none (col 161 complete, 41,421/41,421).
proposed_fix: Explicit validation with a named error.
proposed_test: Test that a None/NaN timestamp raises a specific, documented exception.

title: parameter_hash does not encode the C2 predecessor reference or the tie-key reading
evidence: [INSPECTED] hash input contains order=first_ts,first_src,parent_id and link text but nothing distinguishing previous-parent vs running-max reference; sensitivity views are separated only by the __SENS_ id suffix.
impact: A reader of parameter_hash alone cannot distinguish the approved C2 rule from the running-max variant.
proposed_fix: Add c2_reference to the hash payload (changes hashes; needs decision).
proposed_test: Assert param_hash differs between c2_ref variants.

title: Committed manifest records generated_at_head 5b2939ec with working_tree_dirty=true
evidence: [REPRO] the 5b2939ec commit is an ancestor of HEAD; all 6 gz files match manifest hashes; current engine code reproduces the six text hashes (own detector baseline REPRO=[]), so the content is reproducible even though the stamped head is not the producing clean commit.
repro: sha256 of decompressed files vs manifest
impact: Provenance stamp is weak; content verified.
proposed_fix: Regenerate from a clean tree at the audited commit if a clean stamp is wanted.
